title: Cousin Auguste, teaching himself guitar, early dances
summary: He learned guitar on his cousin Auguste's instrument, then corrected a wrong chord at a family supper at age 14-15 and was brought in to play. The same long answer lists the dances of the time and his firing for the Perez, Golden Rule and Bowling bands.
